description: Read cached earnings-call paragraphs for one exact Bullrun ticker, optionally filtered by fiscal period or search text. A best-effort free background import collects at most the two latest retained calls from DefeatBeta for supported US listings, with a 24-hour stored-data cooldown; the first read may be empty. Coverage and source publication lag vary. Speaker names and paragraph order are retained; roles and prepared/Q&A section labels may be unavailable. This is a read-only research operation. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

maxCharsPerChunk.description: Maximum characters per transcript chunk in the MCP response.

maxChunks.description: Maximum speaker-tagged transcript chunks to return.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text/speaker search across transcript chunks.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun, e.g. "CRWD", "SPGI", "V".

name: get_earnings_call_transcript
title: Get earnings call transcript
